meta.scope: official Train rows only (3360); Train-sub 2856 / Dev 504
meta.label_policy: non-Train label entries are masked to NaN immediately after loading and are never used

split.assignment_rule: sorted scaffold keys -> numpy default_rng(seed).permutation -> greedy add whole groups while not exceeding the target
split.scaffold_definition: rdkit Bemis-Murcko, acyclic molecules keyed by their own SMILES

meta.eval_scopes: Train-sub--Dev cross pairs (primary) and Dev--Dev pairs (secondary)

A_transformation_only.definition: seen exact type: Train-sub empirical mean delta shrunk to the Train-sub global mean; unseen type: global mean
A_transformation_only.support_policy: lomo: exclude Train-sub pairs sharing either molecule with the evaluation pair; full reported as a secondary anchor
A_transformation_only.lomo_note: Train-sub pairs contain only Train-sub molecules and Dev pairs contain at least one Dev molecule, so no Train-sub pair can share a molecule with an evaluation pair; A_lomo and A_full coincide on both eval scopes.

B_context_conditioned_linear.definition: A + ridge context correction using fixed radius-1/radius-2 environment descriptors
B_context_conditioned_linear.feature_blocks: compact composition/scalars + rooted WL fingerprint (2 iterations, 256 bits per ball), radius-1 and radius-2

definitions.cross_scope: pairs with one Train-sub endpoint and one Dev endpoint

evaluation_coverage.note: transfer conclusions apply to the matched-pair evaluation subset, not all 504 Dev molecules

bootstrap.dev_dev_cluster: full Train pair component (72 clusters, 611 pairs)

notes: No pair containing a Dev molecule is used to fit A or B.
The LOMO support policy excludes any Train-sub pair sharing either molecule with the evaluation pair; for cross pairs this prevents the train endpoint's label from entering its own type mean.
B is fitted on Train-sub residuals only; feature vocabulary, standardisation and ridge coefficients use no Dev label.
The post-hoc lambda=100 block is a robustness check, not a model-selection step.
Metrics are delta-level; they are not whole-molecule RMSE and are not comparable to the parent rounds' whole-molecule tables.
